lines.text: David asks the LORD to hear his plea, saying God has tested him and found no evil.
By the word of God's lips, David has avoided the ways of the violent, and his feet have not slipped.
David asks God to save with His left hand and hide him in the shadow of His wings.
David's enemies have tracked him down and surround him like a bear greedy for prey.
David asks the LORD to bring his enemies to their knees, and he will be satisfied in God's presence when he awakes.
